email.subject1: a signal play for 365 Retail Markets
email.body1:
David, saw 365 Retail Markets closed the $848M Cantaloupe acquisition, adding nearly 40,000 customers and new venue types.

An integration that size means far more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for 365 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for 365 Retail Markets.

Post-acquisition, the addressable base just jumped across new environments like hospitality and transit, and pipeline expectations tend to outrun headcount. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to work the expanded base, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings 365 needs to cover that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for 365 Retail Markets.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how 365's reply rate likely compares to peer commerce-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Folding in 40,000 new customers is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to 365 either way.
